prs.title: fix: respect disabled listChanged capabilities on v1.x
prs.author: paulelliotco
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: When listChanged: false is explicitly set in server capabilities, the SDK was ignoring it — either overwriting it to true during tool/resource/prompt registration (mcp.ts) or sending notifications unconditionally (index.ts sendXxxListChanged methods). (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: When listChanged: false is explicitly set in server capabilities, the SDK was ignoring it — either overwriting it to true during tool/resource/prompt registration (mcp.ts) or sending notifications unconditionally (index.ts sendXxxListChanged methods). (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 is a superset of #1937. Both make the identical index.ts change (getCapabilities private→public) and both touch mcp.ts. However, #1948 also adds explicit listChanged guards inside sendResourceListChanged(), sendToolListChanged(), and sendPromptListChanged() in index.ts — a defensive backstop that #1937 lacks entirely. Keeping #1948 covers both the registration-time fix and the notification-send-time fix in one PR.

prs.reason: [llm pick] cluster primary for issue #1471: All three PRs have unknown CI, so that criterion doesn't differentiate. On "has tests": #2009 touches 4 files vs. 2 files each for #1509 and #1975 — with 4 changed files on a 2-file source fix, the extra 2 files are almost certainly test files, while the 2-file PRs likely touch only the source and possibly a type definition with no test coverage added. clusters.pick_reason: PR #1948 is a superset of #1937. Both make the identical index.ts change (getCapabilities private→public) and both touch mcp.ts. However, #1948 also adds explicit listChanged guards inside sendResourceListChanged(), sendToolListChanged(), and sendPromptListChanged() in index.ts — a defensive backstop that #1937 lacks entirely. Keeping #1948 covers both the registration-time fix and the notification-send-time fix in one PR.
